# Exude Human Capital

> > Exude HC is a specialized HR consulting firm offering expert guidance in human resources, diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging (DEIB), and leadership development.

Based in Philadelphia, Exude Human Capital (Exude HC) provides comprehensive HR consulting, outsourcing, and training services to organizations seeking to build inclusive, high-performing workplaces. The firm specializes in strategic HR advisory, DEIB initiatives, talent management, and organizational development.

## Key Topics

- HR Consulting
- DEIB (Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Belonging)
- Strategic Advisory
- Leadership Development
- Performance Management
- HRIS Implementation
- Compensation & Total Rewards
- Employee Experience
- Organizational Assessment
- HR Outsourcing
- Talent Management
- Inclusive Culture
- Employee Surveys
- HR Training & Compliance
- Succession Planning

- [HR Outsourcing Services](https://exudehc.com/solutions/human-resources/human-resources-outsourcing): HR outsourcing: interim, ongoing, and project-based support services
- [Strategic Advisory](https://exudehc.com/solutions/human-resources/strategic-advisory): Strategic HR advisory aligned with organizational goals and objectives
- [Performance Management Consulting](https://exudehc.com/solutions/human-resources/performance-management): Performance management design, implementation, and modernization services
- [Compensation and Total Rewards](https://exudehc.com/solutions/human-resources/compensation): Compensation consulting, benchmarking, and total rewards strategy

## DEIB Solutions

- [DEIB Strategy and Consulting](https://exudehc.com/solutions/diversity-equity-inclusion/diversity-strategy): Custom DEIB strategy development and inclusive workplace consulting
- [Inclusive Culture Alignment Tool](https://exudehc.com/solutions/diversity-equity-inclusion/inclusive-culture-alignment-tool): Inclusive Culture Alignment tool for DEIB strategy and culture alignment
- [DEIB Training Programs](https://exudehc.com/solutions/diversity-equity-inclusion/deib-training): DEIB training courses on allyship, inclusive communication, and belonging
- [DEIB Surveys and Focus Groups](https://exudehc.com/solutions/diversity-equity-inclusion/deib-data-collection): DEIB surveys, focus groups, and data collection for employee perceptions
- [DEIB Facilitated Conversations](https://exudehc.com/solutions/diversity-equity-inclusion/deib-facilitated-conversations): Facilitated conversations for shifting knowledge and perceptions on DEIB
